Build prompt

Build “Fitness Coach Weekly Check-In Form” on NeoApps for a fitness coach. Collect weekly client-entered sleep, weight and optional meal photos in a private coach view. Limit each participant to their assigned workspace and give managers scoped access. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Two clients submit the same week. The coach sees both and each client sees only their own history.
